cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Back My Version
cards.instruction: Recruit someone to remember, repeat, and defend one shared version of events when questions begin.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. The caretaker's asking about our extra key. Tell him we were checking the cake cupboard's lock.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We did check it. Then we ate the cake.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Start with the part we both remember as maintenance.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He'll ask why there are crumbs in the lock.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we both remember a blockage. Say that back so we're consistent.
